title: Pump and system operating point
description: Reusable SVG component showing the analytical intersection of a quadratic pump curve and quadratic system curve with explicit SI parameters.
learningObjectives: Locate the operating point where pump head equals required system head.
Distinguish shutoff head, static head, friction/system losses, and hydraulic versus shaft power.

verification.notes: Analytical curve intersection and power calculation reviewed from source; live browser/accessibility review pending.
